user.title: go2rtc Audio Diffusion
user.description: Dedicated go2rtc instance, independent from Frigate, to broadcast audio on your two-way audio cameras.

add_camera.title: Add a camera
add_camera.description:
{found_cameras}

Pick an existing camera for automatic detection (Reolink confirmed; Hikvision/Dahua/Amcrest best-effort, untested), OR pick the brand yourself with the address found above, OR fill the custom URL.

data.name: Name (e.g. reofront)
data.camera_entity: Existing camera (optional, pre-fills the address if possible)
data.brand_choice: Brand (pick it yourself if automatic detection fails, e.g. camera via Frigate)
data.host: Address (IP or hostname) — if brand picked
data.backchannel: Enable two-way audio (#backchannel=1) — custom URL only

data_description.camera_entity: Leave empty to use the custom URL below instead.
data_description.stream_url: Only used if no camera is selected above.

error.brand_not_recognized: Brand not auto-detected (e.g. camera exposed via Frigate) — pick the brand yourself from the list, or use the custom URL.
error.password_required: Password is required to build the URL automatically.
error.host_required: Address (IP/hostname) is required — automatic pre-fill isn't possible for this camera, enter it yourself.
error.need_entity_or_url: Pick an existing camera OR fill the custom URL.

diffuser.name: Broadcast audio to camera
diffuser.description: Broadcasts a TTS message, an audio file, or a live radio stream to a two-way audio camera.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera name as added in the integration configuration.

radio_url.name: Live radio stream (URL)
radio_url.description: URL of a radio/live stream to broadcast continuously.

message.name: Message to say (TTS)
message.description: Text to convert to speech and broadcast.

moteur_tts.name: TTS engine
moteur_tts.description: Engine to use with "Message to say" (default Piper). Lists all installed TTS engines.

voice.name: Voice (optional)
voice.description: Exact voice identifier (voice_id) to use, if the chosen engine supports several. Leave empty for the engine's default voice. To find available voices, use the "TTS voice" selector on the integration page for the camera in question.

media_file.name: Server audio file
media_file.description: Pick an audio file already present in the Home Assistant media library.

upload_file.name: Upload an audio file
upload_file.description: Send an audio file directly from your computer or phone.
